title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法 (Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services)
notes: gov.cn (primary/official, CAC-issued), full Chinese text, 24 articles / 5 chapters. Effective 2023-08-15. Scope: services to PRC domestic public. Tolerant-prudent + classified/tiered regulation. Prohibited content list (Art.4). Training-data rules (Art.7), annotation rules (Art.8). Service norms: minor over-reliance prevention, deep-synthesis labeling, input/record protection (Art.10-12). Security assessment + algorithm filing for public-opinion/social-mobilization services (Art.17). Cross-border technical measures (Art.20). Penalties per Cybersecurity/Data Security/PIPL/Sci-Tech Progress Law (Art.21).
